article.headline: Jazz and Suns meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Phoenix Suns (7-7, 11th in the Western Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (3-13, 14th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Jazz and Suns meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Jazz and Suns meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Phoenix Suns (7-7, 11th in the Western Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (3-13, 14th in the Western Conference) Salt Lake City; Friday, 9:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: The Phoenix Suns travel to face the Phoenix Suns in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Jazz have gone 3-11 against Western Conference teams. Utah gives up 116.0 points and has been outscored by 7.2 points per game. The Suns have gone 5-7 against Western Conference opponents. Phoenix has a 2-7 record against teams over .500. The Jazz score 108.8 points per game, 6.9 fewer points than the 115.7 the Suns allow. The Suns average 114.1 points per game, 1.9 fewer than the 116.0 the Jazz allow to opponents. TOP PERFORMERS: Keyonte George is averaging 21.6 points and 7.1 assists for the Jazz. Darryn Peterson is averaging 2.5 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. Miles Bridges is averaging 14.6 points, 6.9 rebounds and 3.1 assists for the Suns. Devin Booker is averaging 25.8 points over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Jazz: 2-8, averaging 108.8 points, 43.9 rebounds, 24.5 assists, 7.5 steals and 5.4 blocks per game while shooting 45.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 114.3 points per game. Suns: 6-4, averaging 114.9 points, 40.2 rebounds, 27.7 assists, 7.6 steals and 3.6 blocks per game while shooting 48.0% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 112.2 points. INJURIES: Jazz: Lauri Markkanen: out (wrist), Jusuf Nurkic: out (foot), Jaren Jackson Jr.: out (knee). Suns: Mark Williams: out (shoulder). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
